hint.title: Three quick tips
hint.1: 1. Tap a landmark to read about it; places with a 3D model open in 3D from the card.
hint.1b: “Go here” and “Ask about this” at the bottom of a card only fill the chat box — they never send for you.
hint.2: 2. The map opens on the world map by default; tap “Current location” to jump to where you are and highlight it. If a place isn’t recognised you’ll see “Not on map: …” — tap it to place it.
hint.3: 3. Layers, labels, characters and 3D quality are in Settings (⋯ at the bottom right on phones).
hint.3d: 3. Layers, labels, characters and 3D quality are in Settings at the top right.
hint.4: 4. Editing history floors / regenerating: swipes, deleting or editing buildings and branching a map all recompute automatically — except position text you hand-edit on a history floor. Edit on the newest floor, or branch from that floor and regenerate.
